1. Treat the entire submitted output as falsified. A rejection does not identify which part failed; do not assume it was a serialization issue or one local cell unless the evaluator says so.

    pts = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != 0]

    core = [(r, c) for r, c in pts if grid[r][c] == inside]
    ir0, ir1 = min(r for r,c in core), max(r for r,c in core)
    ic0, ic1 = min(c for r,c in core), max(c for r,c in core)
